additional_info.subject: RE: ID0442577-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000687] Fan rotation disabled CRM:02889000394
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
We need to investigate if there is issue with the Fan or the Loose wirings.
You can also refer to the knowledge Article -
KA-07713
Referring to the below picture, have to carry out following activities for troubleshooting :
1. Check the voltage between L3 and N3, Voltage should be around 230 v.
2. Check for the voltage between 24v1,.3 and Ground, Voltage should be around
3. Check for the loose wiring of the XD7 connector. If it is found to be loose or broken have to be replaced. You check for the spare part at
Sicharge D - Spare Parts Cat. C (sharepoint.com)
4. Check for the continuity from the DI9 pin of KF5 to the 6th Pin of Fan.
